{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1oeohee",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The lack of a specific configuration drawing or recent change briefing (condition) means the crew's interpretation of system state relies on general knowledge and status bits like 'C-11 RUN', which are insufficient to prove local flow availability.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had a verified configuration drawing and recent briefing, they would not rely on ambiguous status bits to determine flow availability.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by an upstream event unrelated to local knowledge gaps.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need evidence of what specific information sources (drawings vs. logs) the crew relied upon at 10:00 AM."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-zt9vpk",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Absence of interview data on fatigue or intent prevents assessing whether human error contributed to misinterpreting system status.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If fatigue or workload were high, the crew might have missed a subtle pressure drop.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was purely mechanical and unrelated to human state.",
      "evidenceGap": "No interview records exist; this remains an unknown factor."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-rga8k8",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Desk entries not logging every field operation means the official record does not capture real-time valve states or pressure readings, creating a gap between recorded status and actual conditions.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If every field operation were logged, the record would reflect actual valve positions and pressure states.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by a system failure not dependent on logging practices.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to determine if unlogged operations led to an unsafe state."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1jn9d4s",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "'Normal band' is a qualitative operator entry, not a precise measurement. This ambiguity allows for misinterpretation of pressure status.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If 'Normal band' were a precise numeric measurement, the status would be unambiguous.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by an external factor unrelated to record interpretation.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need exact pressure values at 10:00 AM."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-x3ngwa",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The area directory is a location index and does not establish valve positions or pressure availability. Relying on it for system state leads to uncertainty.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the area directory established valve positions, system state would be known.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by a failure in the distribution network not reflected in location indices.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need to find records that do establish pressure availability."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-109kb97",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The blank temporary instruction attachment field indicates no documented control for recent changes, increasing risk of unmanaged service routing issues.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a temporary instruction were attached, changes would be documented and controlled.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by an upstream event unrelated to documentation gaps.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need evidence of any recent service-routing changes."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1cqfb1k",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Lack of documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment or response steps means the crew may not have been prepared for unexpected events.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If confirmation of understanding existed, the crew would have been better prepared.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by a mechanical failure not dependent on training or briefing.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need evidence of any informal briefings that occurred."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-13979pa",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Uncertainty about whether the crew saw recent changes or used a different version of equipment-location sheets creates risk of acting on outdated information.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew used current, verified drawings, they would not act on outdated information.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by an upstream event unrelated to drawing versions.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need evidence of which version of equipment-location sheets were in use."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-x2152q",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The incident description does not establish the origin of the interruption, leaving open possibilities like upstream source failure or distribution network issue.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "incident-description#structuredIncident.summary"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the origin were established as downstream, it would point to local equipment failure.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by an upstream event unrelated to local conditions.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need pressure data from multiple points to triangulate source."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-6lcr51",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No line opening was authorized at the time of acknowledgment, meaning any valve manipulation would be unauthorized or undocumented.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening were authorized, it would be documented and controlled.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by an upstream event unrelated to valve manipulation.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need evidence of any unauthorized valve manipulations."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "'Air-low' indication suggests a pressure drop, but without precise measurements or location data, the cause is ambiguous.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the indication were accompanied by precise pressure data, the cause would be clearer.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by a sensor malfunction unrelated to actual pressure drop.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need point register data for P-R at 10:00 AM."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-6748yt",
      "toKey": "n-rmrljn",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Utilities acknowledged receipt and paused work, indicating the event was recognized but not fully understood.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "kb:communication-supervision"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If Utilities had a deeper understanding of the cause, they might have taken corrective action sooner.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption was caused by an upstream event unrelated to acknowledgment timing.",
      "evidenceGap": "Need evidence of any immediate corrective actions taken."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"Analysis identifies multiple conditions contributing to uncertainty about the instrument-air interruption. Key gaps include lack of precise pressure measurements, unclear origin of the interruption, and potential reliance on outdated or ambiguous information sources.","evidenceUsed":["incident-description","24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],"unknowns":["Exact pressure values at 10:00 AM.","Origin of the interruption (upstream vs. downstream).","Whether recent service-routing changes occurred."],"alternatives":["Upstream source failure.","Distribution network issue.","Local equipment malfunction.","Sensor malfunction or false indication."],"confidence":0.65},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId\":\"req-1\",\"sourceId\":\"da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1\",\"claimRef\":null,\"instruction\":\"Retrieve point register data for P-R at 10:00 AM to determine exact pressure values and location of the interruption.","rationale\":\"This will clarify whether the 'air-low' indication was accurate and where in the system it occurred."
  ]}
